attributes.residual:
THREE DESIGN REVERSALS, each forced by measurement, each the opposite of the item's stated cure. (1) ITEM 2. The reporting record's fix (a) was 'catch nothing -- fix the call'. Fixing hv_formfirst's `corrected_classify(ow, tw)` signature would have REINSTATED A CRUDER CLASSIFIER ON TOP OF A BETTER SHIPPED ONE: `ha_close.classify` has since GROWN the repair as a parameter (`classify(ow, tw, form_first=False)`) and `ha_close.build_rule` now ENUMERATES both arrow orders, restricting form-first to the li<->copy direction genuinely shadowed — which the local `_form_arrow` did not. The discriminant is one line with no build: `inspect.signature(ha_close.classify)`. Deleting the patch turned the fabricated `0 of 8` into a true `1 of 8 CLOSE`, and the closer is gamemain::fn_80054E78 with `arrow order form-first; families={'fwd': 1, 'regfield': 18}` — exactly what attempt.HV_fn80054e78-arrow-order-reclassification.20260901.v1 records and names THIS FILE as the reproduction for. The live tool had been contradicting the corpus. (2) ITEM 5. The item asked to implement the size-sequence match a lane ran by hand for enemy.c's .data. That base is MECHANICALLY RESOLVABLE from the relocations once named target symbols stop being dropped, and the tool now prints the landed claim verbatim, so the procedure ships ADVISORY-ONLY — see claim.law.T23_a-named-target-symbol-decides-a-data-base-that-a-size-sequence-can-only-guess.20260904.v1 for why a thin paste-ready base is worse than none. (3) ITEM 9. The item asked for 'a --compact/summary mode' as though none existed. TWO do, and `python memory_graph/gdlmem.py brief --help` shows one in a single command: --roster-only takes game/enemy/enemy from 254,306 bytes to 15,238. The COMPLAINT survives for a reason the item did not name — --roster-only is documented as a RE-READ form omitting the mandatory-step-1 hypotheses and the cross-fleet claim VETOes, so the only choices were a 254 KB briefing or a roster a lane is told not to start from. --summary is the missing middle: 44,312 B, hypotheses and claims and roster whole, everything else reduced to counts plus record ids.

TWO OBSERVATIONS DID NOT REPRODUCE, both inside item 7, and BOTH were measured before the cure was written. (a) `--arbitrate` leaving a STALE OBJECT: the rebuild landed with --arbitrate itself (cd480723c). On game/ps2/fakelib::sceOpen with a `volatile int` local (real 24 vs 44) the object after --arbitrate is byte-identical to the one built from the EDITED source and the following ninja correctly prints `no work to do`. The residual is the law's own second sentence — the rebuild is SILENT on success — so the cure is a MESSAGE, not a rebuild. (b) `--no-bank` moving the BEST anchor reproduces ONLY when the verdict is BASELINE, a precondition neither the law nor the item states: with an anchor present a worse state classifies `REGRESSED vs best 24` and banks nothing. A cure written to the item's wording would have been aimed at a path that already behaves.

A THIRD ARTIFACT HAD INHERITED ITEM 4'S MISREAD. The run-52 report names a work order and an accepted record; the misread was also PINNED BY A PASSING TEST — test_t18_word_decode.py asserted `decode_word_class(0x38600004, 0x38640004) == 'REGFIELD-ONLY'` with the comment 'a register slot in BOTH forms, so it is a recolour'. A shipped assertion is the strongest form this error takes.

EVIDENCE ANSWERING AN ACCEPTED LAW'S OWN FALSIFIER (item 6). claim.law.CX_a-datadiff-sections-flip-blocker...v1 says every one of its 38 blocker lines carries the shape `SIZE target 0x0 vs ours 0xNN`, and its falsifier invites someone to look outside the distance 0-3 band it measured. Measured image-wide over every splits.txt unit with both objects built (1 skipped): 93 blocker rows over 39 units take the new UNCLAIMED SECTION verdict — 2.4x the law's 38 — and EXACTLY ONE blocker is not of that shape: `dolphin/demo/DEMOInit.c .sbss target 0x20 vs ours 0x28`, both sides nonzero. Zero rows are target-0x0-AND-claimed. So the law holds inside its band and its universal shape claim does not hold image-wide, which is why the new verdict is decided per row against the live splits.txt instead of being asserted.

attributes.workflow_criticism: FOUR DEFECTS IN THIS WORK ORDER ITSELF, all of the kind AGENTS.md dispatch screens already name. (1) ITEM 9 ASSERTS AN ABSENCE WITHOUT ITS QUERY — run 46's rule, and `gdlmem.py brief --help` refutes it in one command. The cheapest claims to write remain the most expensive to act on. (2) ITEM 2 QUOTES AN EXIT CODE THAT IS WRONG IN THE SAFE DIRECTION: the cited record says hv_formfirst 'exits 1'; measured twice, it exits 0, so the fabricated negative is also reported as a SUCCESS to any scripted caller. A wrong exit code in an order is not cosmetic — it is the difference between a lane that notices and one that does not. (3) ITEM 7 OMITS THE PRECONDITION ON WHICH ITS OWN REPRODUCTION DEPENDS. '--no-bank must not move the BEST anchor' reproduces only when the verdict is BASELINE; the first probe written to the order's wording measured the opposite and was correct. An order stating a symptom must state the state the symptom needs, or the lane's first measurement refutes the item and the item is still right. (4) ITEM 9's '3 staleness paragraphs repeated on all 62 rows' is 2, measured — and the item's '103KB/5182 lines' is 254,306 B / 5,063 lines on the TU I ran. Both are the run-41 rule ('a number in a brief needs a record id') applied to a number nobody re-measured. ONE PROCESS OBSERVATION WORTH MORE THAN THE FOUR: the order's own instruction to reproduce BEFORE deriving a cure was worth three design reversals and two refuted observations out of nine items — five of nine items would have shipped a wrong or unnecessary change if the stated cures had been executed. That is the third consecutive tool lane at roughly that rate (run 50: three of three; run 52: two of two), which is now enough evidence to say the stated CURE in a tool-queue item carries no predictive value at all, while the stated OBSERVATION carries a great deal. The queue format should drop the cure clause entirely rather than continue asking lanes to ignore it.
